scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:api-client && npm run test:session && npm run test:brand && npm run test:auth && npm run test:data-authorization && npm run test:excel && npm run test:weather && npm run test:weather-navigation && npm run test:weather-export && npm run test:weather-csv

scripts.test:excel: tsc src/excelMatchConfig.ts --target ES2020 --module ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --outDir .test-dist --skipLibCheck && node --test tests/excelMatchConfig.test.mjs

scripts.test:weather-navigation: tsc src/mallWeatherNavigation.ts --target ES2020 --module ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --outDir .test-dist --skipLibCheck && node --test tests/mallWeatherNavigation.test.mjs
scripts.test:weather-export: tsc src/mallWeatherExport.ts --target ES2020 --module ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --outDir .test-dist --skipLibCheck && node --test tests/mallWeatherExport.test.mjs
